title: Resolution opposing cuts to federal Head Start rules
summary: This resolution opposes a federal proposal, released August 6 2026, that would roll back Head Start regulations by cutting staff-to-child ratio rules, dropping staff qualification requirements and mandating English-only instruction. It calls on the federal government to instead prioritize protecting and expanding access to high-quality early education. In New York State, Head Start serves about 43,300 children, and the English-only rule could affect many of the state's 554,000 multilingual young children.
